stdout:
usage: log config [options] --mode <modes>
   or: log config [options] --status
   or: log config [options] --reset

description:
    Read or configure settings for the logging system. Configuration
    can act system-wide; or on a subsystem, category, or process level.

options:
    -c, --category <name>         Get/set settings for a given category
    -j, --json                    Output status in JSON format (use with --status, not supported on simulator)
    -m, --mode <modes>            Set mode using key:value pairs (comma-separated)
    -p, --process <pid> | <name>  Get/set settings for a given process
    -r, --reset                   Reset settings to defaults
    -s, --status                  Show current settings
    -S, --subsystem <name>        Get/set settings for a given subsystem

modes:
    Modes are specified as key:value pairs, separated by commas.
    Examples:
      --mode level:info                                    (single setting)
      --mode level:info,persist:debug,signpost-enabled:on  (multiple settings)

    Valid keys and their values are:

    level                         off | default | info | debug
    persist                       off | default | info | debug
    stream                        live | default
    signpost-persisted            off | on | default (subsystem/category)
    signpost-enabled              off | on | default (subsystem/category)
    signpost-backtrace-enabled    off | on | default (subsystem/category)
    oversize-enabled              off | on | default (subsystem/category)

scope:
    System-wide: level, persist, stream
    Subsystem: level, persist, signpost-persisted, signpost-enabled, signpost-backtrace-enabled, oversize-enabled
    Category: level, persist, signpost-persisted, signpost-enabled, signpost-backtrace-enabled, oversize-enabled
    Process: level, persist, stream

notes:
    - signpost and oversize settings require --subsystem (and optionally --category)
    - signpost and oversize settings are shown in --status for subsystems and categories
